subject: SAC-B6c family-local contribution outside global residual
intent: Measure whether B2 family-local competition still contributes dimensions outside the global residual as capacity scales, before changing any adaptive budget policy.

diagnosticFields: family unique dimensions beyond global residual
local incremental dimensions in merged signature
stopLines: local incremental zero in one fixture != local competition is generally unnecessary
containment correlation != causal explanation of retrieval quality

fixture.source: B6/B6b capacityEvalItems anchor with B1 family normalization and B2 equal-local half-global residual policy

findings: The merged signature retains local dimensions outside the residual for small, medium, and large profiles, but the incremental count falls to zero in the oversized profile.

Grouping contributes no dimensions outside the residual in this anchor at any evaluated profile; graph and provenance cease adding dimensions by the large profile; text remains the only incremental family at large and is fully contained at oversized.
At oversized capacity every family-local winner is already present in the 256-dimension global residual, so B2 local+global merge becomes identical to the residual signature for this anchor.
The existing B6 fixture keeps positive desired-minus-distractor margins through large and fails only at oversized, but containment is not treated as a causal or sufficient failure criterion.

Scaling the global residual with total Active can progressively absorb the dimensions that made localized competition distinct, so future capacity policy evaluation should vary residual scaling separately from local scaling rather than assuming a fixed 50/50 ratio remains meaningful.

independentReconstruction.method: Independent deterministic reconstruction of the current feature hashing, B1 family normalization, B2 family-local selection, global residual selection, and signature union.
independentReconstruction.result: matched family unique-beyond-residual counts 4/4/3/0, 8/6/6/0, 16/0/0/0, and 0/0/0/0 across the four profiles.
